answer: Every identity posts a 120 POA bond leaking 20 POA monthly while its record stays hollow, so a thousand idle fakes bleed 20,000 POA monthly standing still. A new identity gets one comet window, 30 days to finish its first real job; no finished work means no second window. Five random auditors check the monthly receipts, and a faked one costs the bond plus a three-year bar on the key. One caught fake sends a ripple through its sponsor's other identities, each facing a fresh audit in a week.
